Package com.tonic.analysis.query.eval

Class EvalContext

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.query.eval.EvalContext
  • public final class EvalContext
extends Object
    Per-subject evaluation scope with lazy, cached views of a method so repeated accessors (every arg(n), instructions, line) share one decode/analysis.

    • Constructor Summary

      Constructors 
      Constructor Description
      EvalContext​(ClassFile classFile, MethodEntry method, EvidenceCollector evidence)
      Creates a scope with no class hierarchy, leaving subtype checks unresolvable.
      EvalContext​(ClassFile classFile, MethodEntry method, EvidenceCollector evidence, Supplier<ClassHierarchy> hierarchySupplier)
      Creates a scope; all cached views start empty and are built on first use.
